project: NLRC Street Runner — World 3: Desert Canyon
updated: round 4 — engine + world systems complete; render pipeline debugged from black screen to lit frame. Colour/composition NOT yet at the quality bar.

gaps.title: BIGGEST REMAINING GAP — the frame is washed out and the canyon has no silhouette
items: Sky occupies ~55% of frame as a flat pale cream field. The reference has a clear peach→violet→blue vertical ramp with a readable sun. Fix: the horizon stop is still far too light and the gradient stops are compressed into the bottom 20% of the dome — respace them against the real view angles the camera actually samples (~-5° to +35°), not 0..1 of the hemisphere.

Canyon walls read as flat pale slabs, not layered terracotta strata. Two causes: (a) fog far=430 still erases the mid/far layers, (b) the near wall is now so low (13.4m) and pushed so far out (13-27m half-width) that it barely enters frame. The wall needs to come back IN to ~8-11m and rise to ~18m so it frames the shot — the earlier 'sky is sealed off' problem was actually the black-sky bug, not wall height. This was a misdiagnosis and must be reverted.
Distant mesa backdrop cards render as light-grey rectangles with visible straight edges — they read as UI panels, not landforms. Needs a proper silhouette shape + haze tint matched to the fog colour.

No visible shadows anywhere in the frame, so nothing is grounded. Shadow camera is 68m wide at 2048px = ~3cm/texel, which should work — likely the shadow bias/normalBias is washing them out, or the sun elevation (6.6°) makes them fall outside the shadow frustum.
Ballast/sleepers read well but the rails have no specular highlight running toward the sun, which is the single strongest 'this is metal rail' cue in the reference.

gaps.title: VERIFIED FIXED this round (each was a real bug found by inspecting rendered output)
items: Boot 92s → 1.5s: texture generation used per-output-pixel JS fbm. Replaced with low-res lattice noise + native canvas upscale (src/render/noisetex.js).
Textures 3000+ → 82 unique: prop generators passed random per-instance seeds straight into the texture cache key. Seeds are now folded into 3-4 quantised variants.
Geometries 3032 → 344: every prop allocated fresh BufferGeometry. Added a quantised shared geometry cache (src/render/geocache.js) with a 0.9+ hit rate.

BLACK SKY: the sky was an r=4000 sphere behind a far=900 camera. Disabling depthTest does not prevent CLIP-plane culling, so it was discarded entirely. Rewritten as a fullscreen NDC triangle that reconstructs the world view ray from the inverse projection — mathematically infinite, unclippable, one primitive.

WHOLE IMAGE ~2 STOPS DARK: the scene renders to a linear HalfFloat target and is composited by a raw ShaderMaterial, so three.js never injected its output colour-space conversion. Added an explicit linear→sRGB OETF at the end of the composite pass.
Page load hung for 90s+: Google Fonts is unreachable in the sandbox and the stylesheet was render-blocking. Made the webfont load non-blocking with a system-font fallback.

streams.name: Render Pipeline Correctness
streams.goal: Frame is lit, colour-managed and free of clipping/culling bugs before any art judgement is made.

rounds.note: Captured first real frame: fully black sky, everything ~2 stops dark.
Diagnosed sky as clip-plane culling (r=4000 sphere vs far=900). Rewrote as fullscreen ray-reconstruction quad.
Diagnosed darkness as missing linear→sRGB encode in the custom composite shader. Fixed. Frame is now correctly exposed.
